title: RADIANT MOTIVE NAVIGATOR • SC HEALTHY CONNECTIONS GUIDE
subtitle: South Carolina Healthy Connections 2027 guide • General information only, not legal or eligibility advice • Guidance reviewed Nov. 22, 2026. Confirm details with SCDHHS.
alert: South Carolina Healthy Connections update (Nov. 2026): For applications made on or after Jan. 1, 2027, CMS guidance describes a one-month retroactive-eligibility limit for the Medicaid expansion adult group and two months for most other Medicaid eligibility groups. SCDHHS materials describe the current Medicaid look-back as up to three months. Retroactive coverage is not automatic; eligibility must have existed when the covered service was provided. SCDHHS is targeting July 2027 for Phase II, which would transition specified home- and community-based waiver, nursing-facility and hospice services into managed care. SCDHHS has proposed July 1, 2027 as the effective date for the consolidated Healthy Connections–Long Term Care waiver; implementation remains subject to CMS approval and operational readiness. Separate federal D-SNP rules beginning in 2027 restrict new enrollment in certain plans affiliated with Medicaid MCOs; they do not require every dual-eligible member to change plans immediately. Use the Medicare + Medicaid pathway to identify questions to ask your plan or a qualified counselor. Review official notices and confirm your situation with SCDHHS.
privacy: Privacy: This guide does not ask for names, Medicaid IDs, diagnoses, health details or document contents. Do not enter patient information. The website host may process standard technical information such as IP address, browser/device details and request timestamps. No patient-level analytics or clinic reporting are enabled. SCDHHS determines eligibility and deadlines.
